title: Transfer Business Central Environments Between Tenants

facts.text: Only internal administrators can initiate and accept environment transfers; delegated admins cannot use this feature.
Transfer must be accepted on destination tenant within 8 hours of creation on source tenant.
On source tenant, select Environments > Environment Transfers, select Transfer Environments, choose environments, enter destination tenant ID, set transfer date/time.
On destination tenant, select Environments > Environment Transfers > Receive Environments, enter source tenant ID, select environments to accept, confirm.
Linked Power Platform environments cannot transfer; must unlink before creating transfer on source tenant.
Early access preview environments can only transfer to destination tenants with Partner Sandbox license.
